summary_en: 500,000 shares (3.77% of shares outstanding excluding treasury), up to ¥500 million total, execution via ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchase, Jul 28, 2026 to Jun 30, 2027. CEO and executive director planned as sellers in ToSTNeT-3 portion; special committee opinion obtained, pricing at prior-day close to ensure fairness.
title_en: Notice of Decision of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 27 July 2026, Seraku Co. Ltd. announced authorization to acquire up to 500,000 treasury shares (3.77% of shares outstanding, calculated as 500,000 ÷ 13,245,095 ex-treasury shares) for up to ¥500 million during the period 28 July 2026 to 30 June 2027. Execution will occur via two methods: (1) off-exchange ToSTNeT-3 trading at the prior day's closing price, and (2) open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The stated rationale encompasses flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions, deployment in M&A, use in incentive plans, and shareholder return. The ToSTNeT-3 component involves the controlling shareholder (Representative Director Miyazaki Tatsumi) and a related executive (Managing Director Miyazaki Hiromi) as intended sellers. To mitigate conflict of interest, the board resolution was deliberated and voted on by only three directors (two independent), excluding the two related parties. A special committee of independent directors issued an opinion on 15 July 2026 confirming that the acquisition preserves fairness and protects minority shareholders, citing the use of ToSTNeT-3 pricing discipline, exclusion of interested directors from decision-making, and equal treatment of all shareholders.
